records.name: idle

Genuine transparent alpha background, no colored backdrop, no added ground shadows, no letters, no humans, no clothes, no props. TOP LEFT: the exact orange-and-white green-eyed kitten, now peacefully SLEEPING, curled into a low cozy ball, eyes closed, tiny smile, tail wrapped around feet. TOP MIDDLE: the exact cream/caramel floppy-eared puppy, now a playful ready-to-fetch pose, slightly crouched forepaws, happy open mouth, tail raised, retain caramel eye patch. TOP RIGHT: the exact honey-brown cream natural rabbit, now peacefully SLEEPING curled with closed eyes, ears relaxed along back, no clothes. records.name: pond

A small crystal-clear woodland pond with a mossy wooden dock at LEFT 35% for separately animated Elsa and snow bunny, rounded willow trees, reeds, tiny pink water lilies and fern-covered rocks along outer edges. Layout MUST make water placement completely legible: RIGHT 55% of screen is open turquoise pond, water surface horizontal around 60% screen height (430 in 720), BELOW that a gentle transparent side-view cutaway underwater area extending to bottom-right, pale sand and a few smooth pebbles on bottom edge, softly lit clear blue water with large empty space for a goldfish swimming. Above/right water surface open space for a duck and flight path for a bird. One simple tree branch extends from right edge near 35% height for a bird to perch. Foreground perspective slightly elevated but with a clearly visible friendly underwater cutaway, like a beautiful animated storybook habitat illustration, not realistic deep dark water. Quiet lower-left dock for translucent UI. Background stream and small waterfall in distant center. No humans, no animals, NO FISH or duck painted in, no signs, no letters, no text, no logos, no UI. Keep performance zones uncluttered, unique WATER habitat unmistakably different from a lawn caravan and a nighttime camp. Render landscape 1536x864 or 1600x900.
